traits.name: Bola Bolt
traits.text: This shot deals no damage, but on a hit, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or be knocked prone and immobilized until it is freed with a successful DC 15 check to Escape. This check can be attempted either by the target or a creature adjacent to the target.
